svg.title: parallel_gripper: breadboard view
svg.desc: Generated by Text to Robot from the robot's wiring record (design.wiring). Each wire carries data-wire, its colour is the wire colour in WIRING.md.
svg.text: Every wire of WIRING.md, in its colour, from pin to pin. Grey bundles are bought leads (USB, camera ribbon).
IEC C14 panel inlet with fuse drawer and rocker switch

path.title: W1 MAINS_L: mains_inlet.load.L to power_supply.ac_in.AC/L, 24 AWG
W2 MAINS_N: mains_inlet.load.N to power_supply.ac_in.AC/N, 24 AWG
W3 MAINS_E: mains_inlet.load.E to power_supply.ac_in.FG, 24 AWG
W4 BUS_SERVO_BUS: servo_bus.servo_bus.SIG to gripper_servo.bus_a.DATA, 26 AWG
W5 GND: servo_bus.servo_bus.GND to gripper_servo.bus_a.GND, 24 AWG
W6 VBUS: servo_bus.servo_bus.VIN to gripper_servo.bus_a.VCC, 24 AWG
W7 VBUS: power_supply.dc_out.DC OUTPUT +V to servo_bus.screw_in.VIN, 24 AWG
W8 GND: power_supply.dc_out.DC OUTPUT -V to servo_bus.screw_in.GND, 24 AWG
